title: Radio: Hilltop Tank — cabinet dark, level falling

fields.orgName: City of Millbrook Department of Water & Sewer

lines.text: Control, Distribution 2 at Hilltop Tank. The radio cabinet is dark — no lights on RP-1 or the RTU.
Sight gauge reads thirty point four feet and you can see it moving. It was thirty-three at five-thirty.

fields.voiceStyle: Woman in her 30s, steady, birds and wind

instructorNote: About 8 ft an hour: roughly four hours to empty. Watch for an IC-1 trigger level.

snapshot.title: Radio Call: Hilltop Tank Hatch Alarm

fields.orgName: City of Millbrook Department of Water & Sewer

lines.text: Control, this is Security. I’ve just received a report from the Hilltop Tank site. A maintenance worker found the roof hatch switch ZS-601 was triggered — the hatch had been manually opened. No sign of forced entry. The site is secured, but the switch is now closed. I’ve locked the door and am posting a guard. I recommend a full site inspection under C1.

fields.voiceStyle: Mid-50s male, steady and measured, with a hint of urgency

snapshot.instructorNote: This inject introduces a physical intrusion indicator. The security team reports a confirmed hatch activation, which contradicts the telemetry failure. Watch for the team to validate the integrity of the control network and confirm no remote access was made before the physical check.
